title: Question bank
description: Every question the tools display, in one place, so the trees, Finder and full assessment cannot diverge in wording or options.

tier.description: The rung this question serves. Omitted for intake questions asked of everyone. A tier's questions are skipped once earlier answers have blocked it.

intake.description: True for the shared intake asked once and prefilled into every tool: stage, the three readiness checks, claim type.

applies_when.description: JSON Logic. The question is asked only when this evaluates true. Absent means always asked.

not_established.description: True where the value means the user has not established this yet, as distinct from having established a negative. Blockers must never fire on such a value.

pack_examples.description: Key looked up in the active context pack for worked examples. Changes what the user sees; never changes a verdict.

establishable.description: Whether this can be settled before the data are in hand. `needs_data` marks a question that cannot honestly be answered until the dataset exists — overlap, density at a cutoff, first-stage strength. Such a question must offer an option marked `not_established`, and no blocker may fire on it: an unchecked assumption is a condition to discharge, never a verdict.
